content: "As the FIFA World Cup approaches, TikTok is leveraging its platform to create immersive experiences that combine social media with collecting and fandom. One key insight is the use of 'wild cards and milestones' to reward users for achieving specific goals or completing tasks. This strategy not only encourages engagement but also creates a sense of community and competition among users. Brands can learn from TikTok's approach to harness the power of user-generated content and create a loyal fan base. #FIFAWorldCup #TikTokMarketing #UserGeneratedContent"
